lines.beaver_en: Oh? Minho, what brings you here?
lines.learner: 지수야, 할 말이 있어서 먼저 왔어.
lines.en: Jisu, I came first because I have something to say.
lines.roman: jisuya, hal mari isseoseo meonjeo wasseo.

lines.beaver_en: What is it? Say it quickly.
lines.learner: 지난번에 내가 너를 놀려서 정말 미안해.
lines.en: I'm really sorry I teased you last time.
lines.roman: jinanbeone naega neoreul nollyeoseo jeongmal mianhae.

lines.beaver_en: You sneered at me in front of friends. I was embarrassed.
lines.en: You must have been. I shouldn't have sneered at you too.

lines.beaver_en: I felt like a fool. Everyone laughed.
lines.en: You were really upset, right? I didn't mean to torment you.

lines.beaver_en: Still, you ignored what I said.
lines.learner: 응, 무시하고 너를 비난까지 했지. 미안해.
lines.en: Yeah, I ignored you and even blamed you. Sorry.
lines.roman: eung, musihago neoreul binankkaji haetji. mianhae.

lines.beaver_en: We fought really badly back then.
lines.en: Right. We should have talked instead of fighting.

lines.beaver: 솔직히 너무 화가 나서 연락 안 했어.
lines.beaver_en: Honestly, I was so angry I didn't contact you.
lines.beaver_roman: soljiki neomu hwaga naseo yeollak an haesseo.
lines.en: I understand. I was scared even you would leave.

lines.beaver_en: Without me, who would you eat lunch with?
lines.en: Exactly. Eating alone, even the food tasted bad.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, okay. I've already forgotten it all.
lines.en: Really? Thank you so much for forgiving me.

lines.beaver: 다음엔 놀리지 마. 점심 먹으러 갈까?
lines.beaver_en: Don't tease me next time. Shall we go eat lunch?
lines.beaver_roman: daeumen nolliji ma. jeomsim meogeureo galkka?
lines.en: Sure! Lunch is on me today.
